name: SamSWAT Optics Port
teaser: A complete rework and remaster of SamSWAT's optics
description_html:
Introduction

Hey guys,

I took at look at SamSWAT’s old sights made for versions past, and I thought maybe I could bring them back.

So here is a completely rebuilt and rebundled version of most of his optics mods. I rebuilt these myself from source models, using all of the same texture values, magnification values, and build structure as the originals but updated with new scripts, new reticle tweaks in some cases, and some specific tweaks to the scripting to make the optics look better.

Other than very small things they should look and work exactly like the original mods.

This mod omits the Leupold LCO and D-Evo because they are already in my main mod, Epic’s All in One

Enjoy!

KNOWN ISSUES:

  • None at the moment
Items Included

This mod includes the following items:

  • PK-AS (Both dovetail and rail mounted)
  • C79A2 (Both black and green)
  • Holosun HS507C (Both red reticle and green reticle)
  • Susat sight

How To Install and Compatibility

How to install:

  1. Download the latest release from the google drive
  2. Open the downloaded zip file with your choice of archive manager (I use WinRAR)
  3. Put the contents of the zip file into your SPT folder
  4. Enjoy!

The standard way to troubleshoot this mod is as follows:

  1. If you have issues when you install this mod, try making a new profile (preferably a dev bear profile) and make sure your game works. I do this by standard with my mod prior to release anyways, so it should always work.
  2. Add your previously used mods and boot the game and run a raid after each installed mod. This is to see if anything is conflicting with my mod. Tell me what is conflicting and what your error message is so that I can verify whether it can be fixed or if it just needs to be added to incompatibilities.
  3. IF YOU HAVE “MISSING PACKAGE JSON” ERROR YOU INSTALLED IT WRONG
  4. If you are using something that is already listed as an incompatibility I am not going to help you.
